rule_text.name: 702.306a
rule_text.rule: Premonition is a static ability that functions while the card with premonition is in a player's hand. "Premonition (cost)" means "Any time you could cast a sorcery, you may pay (cost) and exile this card from your hand. If you do, create a token that's a copy of it. It enters with an additional decayed counter on it. After the current turn has ended, you may cast this card from exile."

rule_text.name: 702.306b
rule_text.rule: Exiling a card using its premonition ability is a special action, which doesn't use the stack. See rule 116, “Special Actions.”
